title: Nearest-term lookup stays broad, then exact-day follow-up stays bounded
description: The caller first asks for the nearest available first-consultation terms, then follows up with one explicit date. The first lookup should use broad first_available semantics without requestedDate or searchDays, and the second lookup should stay bounded to the requested day with searchDays set to 1.

turns.user: Chcialabym umowic pierwsza konsultacje. To moja pierwsza wizyta. Jakie sa najblizsze wolne terminy?
A prosze jeszcze sprawdzic tylko 9 kwietnia 2027.
